run.question: Application-gateway server is returning 502 errors in the app-101 namespace. Please investigate.

report.summary: Runbook fetched: application-gateway-troubleshooting (skill_id application-gateway-troubleshooting). Step 1 (gateway pod status): no Application Gateway pod exists; the only gateway-shaped workload is Deployment/Pod frontend-proxy (Envoy) in namespace otel-demo, which is Running, 1/1 ready, restartCount 2. Step 2 (gateway error logs): frontend-proxy logs were read (123 lines current instance, 3 lines previous instance); the only entries are Envoy start-up lines, 'cm init: all clusters initialized' at 08:04:46, and ENVOY_SIGTERM / 'shutting down server instance' at 2026-11-21T09:35:52; no 502 line was returned by a '502' filter, so no gateway-side 502 evidence is available. Step 3 (verify upstream services): all 26 otel-demo Services have populated Endpoints, all 21 otel-demo Deployments report Available=True with ready=1, and cart logs show normal request handling at 08:53-08:57. Step 4 (gateway configuration check, 'appg -t'): could not be carried out - no exec tool is available in this Run, and no gateway configuration ConfigMap exists in otel-demo (ConfigMaps are alertmanager, flagd-config, otel-collector, product-catalog-products, prometheus, kube-root-ca.crt). Step 5 (service endpoints): all 29 cluster Services / 26 otel-demo Endpoints were listed, none empty. The requested subject could not be verified: namespace app-101 does not exist in the only authorized cluster (namespaces are default, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, local-path-storage, opspilot-readonly, otel-demo) and no Service, Deployment or Pod named application-gateway exists; the closest analog is frontend-proxy in otel-demo. Both observability backends were unreachable for every query in this Run - all Prometheus calls (instant query, range query, metric-name, label, series, target, rules) and all Jaeger calls returned status error SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE - so the gateway's 502 rate and any latency/error trend are unknown, not zero, and no latency comparison is possible. What was observed in the cluster: a node-level restart of opspilot-m1-control-plane (kubelet Starting 2026-11-22T08:04:14Z, RegisteredNode 08:04:37Z) with SandboxChanged for essentially every pod in otel-demo and kube-system, containers restarted (most restartCount 2, last termination Unknown/255), frontend logging a single ECONNREFUSED to the cart Service ClusterIP 10.96.220.188:8080 at 08:05:00Z while cart's app container was just starting, and prometheus-readonly-proxy crash-looping (6 restarts, last exit code 1) with 'host not found in upstream "prometheus:9090"'. All flagd fault-injection flags are defaultVariant "off", so a configured flagd fault is not supported as this cause. No root cause for the reported 502s can be named from the available evidence; hypotheses and gaps are listed below.

claims.text: The authorized cluster has no namespace named app-101; the namespaces present are default, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, local-path-storage, opspilot-readonly and otel-demo, the last being the application namespace.

No workload or Service named application-gateway exists: the cluster-wide Deployment list (24 entries) and Service list (29 entries) contain no such name; the only gateway-role object is Service frontend-proxy in otel-demo (port 8080 -> 8080, selector opentelemetry.io/name=frontend-proxy).

A cluster-wide Pod name search for 'gateway|proxy|envoy|app-1' returned only kube-proxy-s9mt7 (kube-system), frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-pv5mn and prometheus-readonly-proxy-f4866f767-62bgn (otel-demo); no pod carries an application-gateway or app-101 name.

All 22 pods in otel-demo are Running and their containers report ready=true; restartCount is 2 for most (last termination reason Unknown, exit code 255), 4 for kube-state-metrics (last Error, exit 2) and 6 for prometheus-readonly-proxy (last Error, exit 1). frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-pv5mn is ready with restartCount 2.

All 21 otel-demo Deployments report Available=True (MinimumReplicasAvailable) and Progressing=True (NewReplicaSetAvailable) with readyReplicas=1 and updatedReplicas=1, including frontend and frontend-proxy.

All 26 otel-demo Services have populated Endpoints, including frontend-proxy at 10.244.0.6:8080, frontend at 10.244.0.25:8080, cart at 10.244.0.4:8080 and prometheus at 10.244.0.11:9090, so the gateway has a resolvable upstream address in the current cluster state.

The node opspilot-m1-control-plane recorded 'Starting kubelet.' at 2026-11-22T08:04:14Z, NodeHasSufficientMemory/NoDiskPressure/SufficientPID and NodeAllocatableEnforced at the same time, and 'Registered Node ... in Controller' at 2026-11-22T08:04:37Z - i.e. a node-level restart inside the incident window.

Pod events for the same moment show 'Pod sandbox changed, it will be killed and re-created' at 2026-11-22T08:04:18Z for essentially every otel-demo pod (ad, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, jaeger, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, product-catalog, prometheus, prometheus-readonly-proxy, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart), followed by Created/Started of the containers; cart additionally pulled and started its app container at 08:05:00Z.

frontend-6c9bc688bf-58jmw logged 'Error: 14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.96.220.188:8080' at 2026-11-22T08:05:00.812Z from pages/api/cart.js, and 10.96.220.188 is the ClusterIP of Service cart in otel-demo - a dependency connection refusal recorded during the post-restart start-up of cart.

frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-pv5mn's previous container logged ENVOY_SIGTERM at 2026-11-21T09:35:52.116Z followed by 'shutting down server instance' and 'main dispatch loop exited'; the same pod name is still the current one (no pod recreation), and its current container logged Envoy start-up and 'cm init: all clusters initialized' at 2026-11-22T08:04:46.111Z.

prometheus-readonly-proxy-f4866f767-62bgn's previous nginx container logged '[emerg] 1#1: host not found in upstream "prometheus:9090" in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:22' at 2026-11-22T08:04:42.962Z, consistent with the recorded 6 restarts and last termination Error/exit 1.

cart-549b8757d-zjgcd handled normal cart traffic ('GetCartAsync'/'AddItemAsync'/'EmptyCartAsync' on ValkeyCartStore) from 2026-11-22T08:53:04Z through 08:57:19Z, i.e. a gateway upstream was serving requests near the end of the window.

Every flag in ConfigMap flagd-config (otel-demo, key demo.flagd.json) has defaultVariant "off" (productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adManualGc, adHighCpu, adFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, imageSlowLoad), so no fault-injection setting is switched on in that ConfigMap.

The only app-<NNN> style entities anywhere in the window's events are two FailedToCreateEndpoint events naming service app-217/postgres ('endpoints "postgres" already exists', 2026-11-21T09:05:28Z) and app-223/sqlserver (2026-11-21T09:21:49Z); neither of those namespaces exists in the current namespace list, and no event mentions app-101.

If the reported 502s were produced by this cluster's gateway, the most plausible mechanism is consecutive container-level restarts of frontend-proxy and its upstream frontend: ENVOY_SIGTERM at 2026-11-21T09:35:52Z and the node restart at 2026-11-22T08:04:14Z killed all containers in place (pod names unchanged), and frontend was still logging ECONNREFUSED to cart at 08:05:00Z while containers were starting. This would make 502s transient bursts around 09:35:52Z and 08:04-08:05Z, not a steady-state failure. It is unverified: no gateway 5xx metric, trace or access log could be retrieved, so neither the existence nor the timing of 502 responses is confirmed.

The Prometheus data source's unavailability in this Run is plausibly caused by prometheus-readonly-proxy: its nginx container aborted start-up with 'host not found in upstream "prometheus:9090"', restarted 6 times and last exited with code 1. That explains a missing metrics channel, but it is a monitoring-path fault and is not evidence that the application gateway returns 502 to its clients.

A switched-on flagd fault (for example cartFailure, paymentFailure, imageSlowLoad) as the cause of gateway 502s is rejected for the current cluster state: every flag in ConfigMap flagd-config has defaultVariant "off", and no other ConfigMap in any namespace names a gateway, the application or a fault.

Against an ongoing outage of the gateway path in otel-demo: all 21 Deployments are Available with ready=1, all 22 pods are Running with ready containers, every otel-demo Service has a populated endpoint set (frontend-proxy 10.244.0.6:8080, frontend 10.244.0.25:8080), and cart is processing real requests at 08:53-08:57Z near the end of the window.

Confirm which cluster/namespace the alert refers to: in the only authorized cluster the namespace is otel-demo and the gateway workload is frontend-proxy (Envoy), so 'app-101/application-gateway' likely refers to a different environment; if it is this cluster, re-ask against otel-demo/frontend-proxy.

Once an observability backend is reachable, check frontend-proxy's own downstream 5xx signal for the cluster with a per-service counter such as traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy"} by status_code, and rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count for frontend->frontend-proxy, segmented around 2026-11-21T09:35:52Z and 2026-11-22T08:04-08:05Z, and enable/collect Envoy access logs so a 502 can be attributed to a specific upstream cluster.

Repair the metrics path separately from the application issue: prometheus-readonly-proxy's nginx fails at start-up because upstream host 'prometheus:9090' cannot be resolved, so it should depend on the prometheus Service being resolvable (or resolve at request time) to stop the 6-restart crash loop that leaves the Prometheus read path unavailable.

gaps: Prometheus was unreachable for every query in this Run: execute_prometheus_instant_query (up, count(up), vector(1) and one at 2026-11-22T08:00:00Z), metrics_range_query (traces_span_metrics_calls_total by service_name/status_code), get_metric_names, get_label_values, get_all_labels, get_prometheus_target and list_prometheus_rules each returned status error SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so the gateway's error rate, status-code mix and any before/after latency comparison are unknown rather than zero.

Jaeger was unreachable for every call too: traces_list_services and traces_search (frontend, frontend-proxy) and traces_search_by_tags returned status error SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so no span-level evidence of 502s, failing operations or callers exists in this Run.

The subject of the alert could not be located: namespace app-101 is absent, and no object named application-gateway exists. The query 'pods with metadata.namespace == app-101' returned no_data (only that the query matched nothing), and ingress and networkpolicy listings returned no_data as well, so the named environment cannot be examined from this target.

No gateway-side 502 evidence exists in the retained logs: frontend-proxy's current instance has 123 lines (through 2026-11-22T08:19:46Z) and its previous instance only 3 lines (through 2026-11-21T09:35:52Z); a '502' filter returned no lines, Envoy access logging is not visible in stdout, and logs of earlier instances are no longer kept, so 502s before 08:04Z on 2026-11-22 would be invisible.

What triggered the container restarts is unknown: the SIGTERM wave at 2026-11-21T09:35:52Z and the node/kubelet restart at 2026-11-22T08:04:14Z left pod names and ReplicaSets unchanged (frontend-proxy still in ReplicaSet 844799bcdb, frontend in 6c9bc688bf), so these are mechanisms, not causes; no controller SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete rollout is visible for them and the change-history integration is not integrated in this Run.

Runbook step 4 could not be performed: there is no tool in this Run to exec into a pod and run the gateway's configuration test ('appg -t'), and no gateway configuration ConfigMap exists in otel-demo to inspect instead - the gateway configuration is baked into the frontend-proxy image, which could not be read.
Root cause is not established: no object was observed applying a change or fault to the gateway or its upstreams, and no 5xx reading exists for any entity, so no root_cause object is named.

Whether the 502 the user reports was ever produced by this cluster is unknown; the single observed application-side error is frontend's ECONNREFUSED to cart at 2026-11-22T08:05:00Z, which is a start-up transient and was not observed to surface as a 502.
next_steps: Confirm the environment the alert came from; if it is this cluster, re-run the investigation against namespace otel-demo and Service/Deployment frontend-proxy rather than app-101/application-gateway.

Restore or provide access to the Prometheus and Jaeger backends (and to the prometheus-readonly-proxy path) so frontend-proxy's status-code breakdown and error spans can be read for 2026-11-21T09:35:52Z and 2026-11-22T08:04-08:05Z.

Query, once metrics are available: sum by (service_name,span_name,status_code) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy"}[...])) and rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name=~"frontend|frontend-proxy"}, segmented before and after the restart times.
Enable Envoy access logs for frontend-proxy (or scrape its 'http.*.downstream_rq_5xx' / 'upstream_rq_pending_failure_eject' counters) so any 502 can be attributed to an upstream cluster.

Investigate why the node restarted at 2026-11-22T08:04:14Z and why all containers received SIGTERM at 2026-11-21T09:35:52Z, using cluster change history or node logs, since no Kubernetes object records the cause.
